verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client covering clone, commit, push, diff, SSH keys and previews. It is not a Python runtime or terminal environment, so installing Python packages with pip is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it bundles Python or pip; its only scripting mention is a JavaScript console for repository scripts, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install additional pure-Python packages using pip directly on my device
